title: VSCode's SSH Agent Is Bananas (2025)
title_zh: VSCode 的 SSH 代理功能更新

paragraphs.en: We’re interested in getting integrated into the flow VSCode uses to do remote editing over SSH, because everybody is using VSCode now, and, in particular, they’re using forks of VSCode that generate code with LLMs.
paragraphs.zh: 我们希望集成到 VSCode 用于通过 SSH 进行远程编辑的工作流程中，因为现在大家都在使用 VSCode，尤其是他们还在使用通过 LLM 生成代码的 VSCode 分支版本。

paragraphs.en: ”hallucination” is what we call it when LLMs get code wrong; “engineering” is what we call it when people do.
paragraphs.zh: "幻觉"是我们对大语言模型写错代码时的叫法；而人类写错代码时，我们称之为"工程"。

paragraphs.en: LLM-generated code is useful in the general case if you know what you’re doing. But it’s ultra-useful if you can close the loop between the LLM and the execution environment (with an “Agent” setup). There’s lots to say about this, but for the moment: it’s a semi-effective antidote to hallucination: the LLM generates the code, the agent scaffolding runs the code, the code generates errors, the agent feeds it back to the LLM, the process iterates.
paragraphs.zh: 如果你知道自己在做什么，大语言模型生成的代码在一般情况下是有用的。 但如果你能把大语言模型与执行环境之间的闭环打通（采用「智能体」设置），它就会极其有用。 关于这一点有很多可说的，但目前来说：它是对幻觉的一种半有效的解药：大语言模型生成代码，智能体框架运行代码，代码产生错误，智能体把错误反馈给大语言模型，如此往复迭代。

sents.zh: 如果你知道自己在做什么，大语言模型生成的代码在一般情况下是有用的。

sents.zh: 但如果你能把大语言模型与执行环境之间的闭环打通（采用「智能体」设置），它就会极其有用。

sents.en: There’s lots to say about this, but for the moment: it’s a semi-effective antidote to hallucination: the LLM generates the code, the agent scaffolding runs the code, the code generates errors, the agent feeds it back to the LLM, the process iterates.
sents.zh: 关于这一点有很多可说的，但目前来说：它是对幻觉的一种半有效的解药：大语言模型生成代码，智能体框架运行代码，代码产生错误，智能体把错误反馈给大语言模型，如此往复迭代。

paragraphs.en: So, obviously, the issue here is you don’t want this iterative development process happening on your development laptop, because LLMs have boundary issues, and they’ll iterate on your system configuration just as happily on the Git project you happen to be working in. A thing you’d really like to be able to do: run a closed-loop agent-y (“agentic”? is that what we say now) configuration for an LLM, on a clean-slate Linux instance that spins up instantly and that can’t screw you over in any way. You get where we’re going with this.
paragraphs.zh: 所以，很明显，这里的问题在于你不会希望这种迭代开发过程发生在你的开发笔记本上，因为大语言模型存在边界问题，它们会同样乐此不疲地在你的系统配置上迭代，就像对待你恰好正在做的 Git 项目一样。 一件你真正想做到的事：在一个能瞬间启动、且绝不会以任何方式坑到你的全新 Linux 实例上，为大语言模型运行一个闭环的智能体式（「agentic」？现在我们是这么说的吗）配置。 你应该明白我们想说什么了。

sents.en: A thing you’d really like to be able to do: run a closed-loop agent-y (“agentic”? is that what we say now) configuration for an LLM, on a clean-slate Linux instance that spins up instantly and that can’t screw you over in any way.
sents.zh: 一件你真正想做到的事：在一个能瞬间启动、且绝不会以任何方式坑到你的全新 Linux 实例上，为大语言模型运行一个闭环的智能体式（「agentic」？现在我们是这么说的吗）配置。

sents.en: You get where we’re going with this.
sents.zh: 你应该明白我们想说什么了。

paragraphs.en: Anyways! I would like to register a concern.
paragraphs.zh: 无论如何！ 我想提出一个顾虑。

sents.en: I would like to register a concern.

paragraphs.en: Emacs hosts the spiritual forebearer of remote editing systems, a blob of hyper-useful Elisp called “Tramp” . If you can hook Tramp up to any kind of interactive environment — usually, an SSH session — where it can run Bourne shell commands, it can extend Emacs to that environment.
paragraphs.zh: Emacs 承载着远程编辑系统的精神先驱，一个名为「Tramp」的超实用 Elisp 代码库。 只要你能把 Tramp 连接到任何一种交互式环境——通常是 SSH 会话——并能在其中运行 Bourne shell 命令，它就能把 Emacs 扩展到那个环境中。

sents.en: Emacs hosts the spiritual forebearer of remote editing systems, a blob of hyper-useful Elisp called “Tramp” .
sents.zh: Emacs 承载着远程编辑系统的精神先驱，一个名为「Tramp」的超实用 Elisp 代码库。

sents.en: If you can hook Tramp up to any kind of interactive environment — usually, an SSH session — where it can run Bourne shell commands, it can extend Emacs to that environment.
sents.zh: 只要你能把 Tramp 连接到任何一种交互式环境——通常是 SSH 会话——并能在其中运行 Bourne shell 命令，它就能把 Emacs 扩展到那个环境中。

paragraphs.en: So, VSCode has a feature like Tramp. Which, neat, right? You’d think, take Tramp, maybe simplify it a bit, switch out Elisp for Typescript.
paragraphs.zh: 所以，VSCode 有一个类似 Tramp 的功能。这挺不错的，对吧？ 你可能会想，拿 Tramp 来改一改，稍微简化一点，把 Elisp 换成 Typescript。

sents.en: So, VSCode has a feature like Tramp. Which, neat, right?
sents.zh: 所以，VSCode 有一个类似 Tramp 的功能。这挺不错的，对吧？

sents.en: You’d think, take Tramp, maybe simplify it a bit, switch out Elisp for Typescript.
sents.zh: 你可能会想，拿 Tramp 来改一改，稍微简化一点，把 Elisp 换成 Typescript。

paragraphs.en: Unlike Tramp, which lives off the land on the remote connection, VSCode mounts a full-scale invasion: it runs a Bash snippet stager that downloads an agent, including a binary installation of Node.
paragraphs.zh: 与借助远程连接在远程主机上就地取材的 Tramp 不同，VSCode 发动了一场全面入侵：它会运行一个 Bash 片段暂存器，下载一个智能体，其中包括 Node 的二进制安装包。

paragraphs.en: In security-world, there’s a name for tools that work this way. I won’t say it out loud, because that’s not fair to VSCode, but let’s just say the name is murid in nature.
paragraphs.zh: 在安全领域，这种工作方式的工具有一个专门的名字。 我不会大声说出来，因为那对 VSCode 不公平，但只能说这个名字带有“鼠”类的意味。

sents.zh: 在安全领域，这种工作方式的工具有一个专门的名字。

sents.en: I won’t say it out loud, because that’s not fair to VSCode, but let’s just say the name is murid in nature.

paragraphs.en: I would be a little nervous about letting people VSCode-remote-edit stuff on dev servers, and apoplectic if that happened during an incident on something in production.
paragraphs.zh: 让人们在开发服务器上用 VSCode 远程编辑内容，我会感到有些紧张；而如果这种情况发生在生产环境的事故处理期间，我会勃然大怒。

paragraphs.en: It turns out we don’t have to care about any of this to get a custom connection to a Fly Machine working in VSCode, so none of this matters in any kind of deep way, but: we’ve decided to just be a blog again, so: we had to learn this, and now you do too.
paragraphs.zh: 事实证明，要在 VSCode 中实现与 Fly Machine 的自定义连接，我们其实不需要关心这些内容中的任何一项，所以这些东西从任何深层意义上来说都不重要，但是：我们已经决定重新做回一个博客，所以：我们不得不学习这些，现在你也得学了。
